paragraphs: The Khitans rose from the northeastern steppes to establish the Liao dynasty, joining a pastoral heritage with the institutions and technologies of their southern neighbors.
In Age of Empires, their Mounted Trebuchet carries siege warfare on the backs of two camels: an unusual combination of mobility and destructive firepower.
Its fire pots burst among enemy troops and leave flames burning on the ground. The danger continues after the first impact, punishing enemies that remain in the fire.
More mobile than most siege engines, it can reposition to bombard from a distance. But it cannot attack at close range, making the space between the armies vital to its survival.
